question: On 16 March 2022, the Union Ministry for Road Transport and Highways inaugurated a pilot project for hydrogen based advanced Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle (FCEV). This pilot project was initiated by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Toyota Kirloskar Motor Pvt. Ltd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On 16 March 2022, the Union Ministry for Road Transport and Highways inaugurated a pilot project for hydrogen-based advanced Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle (FCEV).
 
• This pilot project was initiated by **Toyota Kirloskar Motor Pvt. Ltd.**.
 
• The project aims to explore and promote hydrogen as an alternative fuel in India.
 
• FCEVs are powered by hydrogen and produce zero emissions, contributing to a cleaner environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hydrogen Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles (FCEVs) use chemical reactions between hydrogen and oxygen to generate electricity, which powers the vehicle's electric motor.
 
• Toyota is a global leader in the development of hydrogen fuel cell technology, with its flagship FCEV model being the Toyota Mirai.
 
• India is exploring hydrogen as a viable alternative to fossil fuels to reduce its carbon footprint and dependence on imported oil.
 
• The success of such pilot projects could pave the way for wider adoption of hydrogen technology in the Indian automotive sector.
